author: GKTed
quote:
Overwhelmingly woke. To all longtime fans of GTA, it is very obvious the game was not only written by people who had nothing to do with previous GTAs, but by writers who probably weren't GTA fans in the first place: likely woke feminists. The staple satirical Rockstar humor seen in previous GTAs has been decimated and turned into what can best be described as millennial, Redditor cringe. A few of the blatant woke examples: the game won't let you run over liberal protestors, and I even came across a patronizing female NPC who wanted to show me what a strong, independent woman she is by not letting me fix her car, proving to Jason that she could do it herself.

The game's sole saving graces are the robberies, gunplay, and driving, but they are vastly overshadowed by the godawful, cringe writing and the stale, dry dialogue that lacks any bite and fails to elicit even a single laugh.

Another triple A game ruined by the woke activitsm and DEI.
